theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The theme leads with a robust trend profile: eligible via the absolute-trend gate (validated risk control), strong durability (0.75, persistent trend), and full breadth (1.0). While crowding flags sizing caution, the gate suggests a favorable risk environment. evidence: Absolute-trend gate validated as risk control (gate_helps=true)
